card.name: Medication error and patient identity checks
card.fires_on: The word "error" (often split as ERR+ORS) right after "medication", and "identity" after "patient's" in verification steps. Both are patient-safety wording.

modes.label: Medication error
modes.description: The word error, or its first piece ERR, after "medication" in warnings and headings.
modes.example: TO REDUCE THE POTENTIAL FOR FATAL MEDICATION<< ERR>>ORS DUE TO INCORRECT ROUT

modes.label: Patient identity check
modes.description: The word identity after "patient's" in instructions to verify the patient before giving a product.
modes.example: 1. Verify patient’s<< identity>> prior to ZEVASKYN application.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward safety words such as "safety" and "safe".
card.plain: It lights up on wording about medication mistakes and confirming the right patient, which are safety themes.
